title: Data and model lineage mismatch
content: A case binds dataset, feature order, split, code, dependency lock, complete calibrated model, threshold, prompt and corpus versions. Reject a missing or stale release identity. A mutable model alias must be resolved once before a batch and replaced by a numeric model version. Do not join results from different releases or silently repair the source.
check: Verify the case release hash against the frozen data, numeric model version, prompt and corpus manifest before interpreting the output.
